[TODO:tr] After a long time he comes back.

excuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Each life answers for itself.
Speak for what is yours.

reward_five.text:
[TODO:tr] The first brings ten talents.
"Well done, good and faithful servant."

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] His joy can be yours too.

envy_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Run Your Race
envy_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Faithfulness, not size, is praised.
You will be measured the same.

reward_two.title: [TODO:tr] Equal Praise
reward_two.text:
[TODO:tr] The second brings four talents.
"Well done. Enter into joy."

small_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] All of It Matters
small_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Two talents earned the same words.
Nothing given is too small.

judgment_one.title: [TODO:tr] I Was Afraid
judgment_one.text:
[TODO:tr] The third holds out a dirty coin.
"I was afraid. I hid it away."

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Fear was never his master's wish.
[TODO:tr] Tears rise for the buried gift.

defend_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Fear Is Not Humility
defend_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] True humility uses the gift.
It does not hide.

ending.title: [TODO:tr] Use What You Hold
ending.text:
